newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Honeywell started as a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Honeywell started as a buy.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth Inc said Wednesday it initiated coverage of Honeywell Inc with a buy rating, citing changes in management and operating culture that should ensure continuing margin improvements.
-- Dain said Honeywell ended 1996 with strong momentum and it expects revenue growth over the next four years will be led by business units positioned for secular growth.
-- Dain set an initial 12-month price target for Honeywell at $84 to $86 a share, providing a potential total return Dain estimates at more than 19 percent.
-- Honeywell develops control, avionics and automation technology.
-- Its shares closed down 1-5/8 Wednesday at 69-7/8.
